newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-MATCH ADVANCED TO ALLOW ISRAELI TO START YOM KIPPUR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MATCH ADVANCED TO ALLOW ISRAELI TO START YOM KIPPUR.

text.p: Celta Vigo will kick off an hour early against Real Betis on Sunday to allow their Israeli international midfielder Haim Revivo start Yom Kippur, the Jewish Day of Atonement.

Revivo, the first Israeli to play in Spain, consulted with a rabbi before agreeing to play at six p.m. which will allow him to get home before sunset and the start of the holiest day in the Jewish calendar.
"It could be a bit of a rush, as I have to eat before the fasting", Revivo said on Wednesday.
"It's the first time I've spent Yom Kippur abroad and it's very important for me to respect what my parents taught me."
